inspiration.observed_pattern: An INSERT IGNORE SELECT must accept SQL_SMALL_RESULT after an outer SELECT inside a derived-table and LEFT JOIN statement.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to two ready candidates, one optional policy lookup, one duplicate target key, and one new target row to isolate nested SELECT modifier normalization and NULL-preserving insertion.

fixture_notes: Candidate 201 conflicts with the existing target row and must remain unchanged; candidate 202 is new and has no policy match, so it must insert with a NULL policy value.
determinism_notes: Candidate IDs and values are fixed; the final target read is ordered by the primary key with no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
setup: CREATE TABLE mini_route_candidates (route_id INT PRIMARY KEY, prefix VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, origin_as INT NOT NULL, state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE mini_policy_registry (prefix VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, origin_as INT NOT NULL, policy_origin_as INT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (prefix, origin_as))
CREATE TABLE mini_validation_entries (route_id INT PRIMARY KEY, prefix VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, origin_as INT NOT NULL, policy_origin_as INT NULL)

steps.sql: INSERT IGNORE INTO mini_validation_entries (route_id, prefix, origin_as, policy_origin_as) SELECT SQL_SMALL_RESULT c.route_id, c.prefix, c.origin_as, p.policy_origin_as FROM (SELECT route_id, prefix, origin_as FROM mini_route_candidates WHERE state = 'ready') c LEFT JOIN mini_policy_registry p ON p.prefix = c.prefix AND p.origin_as = c.origin_as

checks.sql: SELECT route_id, prefix, origin_as, policy_origin_as FROM mini_validation_entries ORDER BY route_id
